BLOCKED_FIXTURE: FBX is a proprietary format with no public specification, its only complete reader is Autodesk's SDK, and neither this package nor CNA's C ABI provides one. A partial reader would disagree with the artist's file silently, which is worse than not reading it. XImporter reads DirectX .x, which every FBX exporter can write, so the model path is reachable. Unblocked by a CNA route that imports FBX.

BLOCKED_UPSTREAM: compiling HLSL needs a shader compiler. CNA's effects.h says at cna_effect_create_compiled that 'this runtime embeds no HLSL compiler and the XNA/FNA toolchain must compile it first', and Python's standard library has none. Everything up to the compiler runs: the input is validated and Defines is parsed. Unblocked by a CNA route that takes effect source and answers bytecode.

BLOCKED_UPSTREAM: rasterizing a named font needs a TrueType rasterizer. Python's standard library has none and CNA's C ABI declares none -- sprite_font.h reads a SpriteFont and does not build one. FontTextureProcessor produces the same SpriteFontContent from a texture and is fully implemented, so the format is reachable. Unblocked by a CNA route that rasterizes a font file into glyphs.
